# Output Files Generated by hru\_cb\_vars

Set `carbon` to `2` in [codes.bsn](../../introduction-1/basin-1/codes.bsn/README.md). Use named rows (`use_obj_lbls = y`) in [print.prt](../../introduction-1/simulation-settings/print.prt/README.md). Set the daily, monthly, or yearly column of `hru_cb_vars` to `y` or lowercase `l`. Both values write one row per full HRU and soil layer at the selected reporting event. Monthly and yearly records contain the values on the last simulated day of the month or year, with no period accumulation by this writer. The legacy caller has no average-annual event. For yearly TXT files, use `hru_cb_vars n n y n`. Set `csvout` to `y` to also write CSV files. [Print row](https://github.com/swat-model/swatplus/blob/aa4179fea9c9fbb9b00efc38e3d4def3b6a3f715/src/basin_print_codes_read.f90#L416), [File opener](https://github.com/swat-model/swatplus/blob/aa4179fea9c9fbb9b00efc38e3d4def3b6a3f715/src/carbon_legacy_module.f90#L581), [Output calls](https://github.com/swat-model/swatplus/blob/aa4179fea9c9fbb9b00efc38e3d4def3b6a3f715/src/command.f90#L550-L559), [Layer writer](https://github.com/swat-model/swatplus/blob/aa4179fea9c9fbb9b00efc38e3d4def3b6a3f715/src/soil_carbvar_write_historical.f90#L27)
